Producer reinspected at native resolution and enlarged Bhattathiri face, joined-hands and seated-body crop. Trivikrama’s one face and two attached arms are coherent; the giant foot and planted foot are visible and each shows five toes. Bhattathiri is a distinct seated figure with a coherent face and joined prayer hands. Skin-only 32×32 medians remain face R−B=123, chest R−B=142 and arm R−B=138. DISCLOSED DEVIATION: Bhattathiri’s two folded feet are naturally concealed beneath his cream dhoti; no foot or toe is visible, so the plan’s visible-feet clause is not met for Bhattathiri. Trivikrama’s feet remain visible. No other defect was observed in the inspected frame and crops. Unapproved; last independent exact-checksum review pending.

Both outermost profile heads are complete and in frame with about 90px side margin each. Central form has two attached arms and two hands; complete symbolic feet row shows five toe marks per visible foot. Central face patches have B-R=17 and 16.

DISCLOSED DEVIATION: Vishnu cheek 32×32 patch at (1292,108) has producer median RGB (79,88,95), B−R=16; independent reviewers measured the same RGB and B−R=16. The face and body read muted slate/blue-gray against Guruvayurappan’s deep-blue contract. No S005 repair round remains. Toe-count disagreement on the unchanged visible Bhattathiri foot: the producer crop review counted four distinct toe forms; independent review-i counted five. Request a focused exact-checksum single-image tiebreak; do not regenerate pending that adjudication. Unapproved.

Producer inspected native image and enlarged face, task-hand and feet crops. Both seated foreground people now have their legs and four feet inside the frame, with about 25–35px lower margin; the visible feet show five toe forms each. Bhattathiri’s visible foot and Vishnu’s two feet are also fully in-frame, with five toe forms on each visible foot. The standing fruit-basket carrier remains a distinct figure with one head and two arms, but his lower legs/feet are hidden behind the seated pair and cannot be counted; full-figure visible-feet compliance remains uncertain. The four ordinary human face 32×32 medians are: seated man at (190,500) RGB (166,84,35), R−B=131; standing man at (400,230) RGB (171,86,36), R−B=135; woman at (535,490) RGB (172,87,35), R−B=137; Bhattathiri at (810,350) RGB (172,88,38), R−B=134. DISCLOSED DEVIATION: these exceed the approximately R−B=120 warm-brown target by 11,15,17,14; skin reads warm brown at full size. Vishnu cheek at (1360,165) RGB (111,113,112), B−R=1, reads gray-blue rather than deep indigo. Unapproved; producer uncertainty and measured deviations sent for independent adjudication.

Producer inspected the native image and enlarged carrier foot, hand and face views, the other faces, and visible feet. The carrier stands separately in front of and beside the seated pair; both legs and feet are fully visible with frame margin. The near foot shows five distinct toe forms; the side-view foot shows one large toe and four separated smaller toe forms. Both hands remain attached; the visible support hand shows a thumb plus four fingers. The seated man, garland maker, Bhattathiri and Guruvayurappan each have one head and two arms; visible feet are in-frame with five toe forms, and Guruvayurappan’s raised open hand shows a thumb plus four fingers. DISCLOSED DEVIATION: skin-only 32×32 medians are carrier (630,225) RGB (181,92,37), R−B=144; seated fruit maker (190,510) RGB (179,91,36), R−B=143; garland maker (445,480) RGB (180,93,37), R−B=143; Bhattathiri (870,360) RGB (177,92,38), R−B=139, against the approximately 120 target. Guruvayurappan cheek at (1355,160) RGB (62,73,91), B−R=29, against the target of at least 40. Anatomy and frame placement pass producer inspection; these palette deviations remain for independent exact-checksum review. Unapproved.
